Rough graven road, cleared dry field.
Deep mud or standing water less than 20 cm deep, drifting sand, dense undergrowth and brush.
Flowing water about 1 metre deep, rocky and unstable terrain, thick forests or ruined cityscapes (fail by 4+ DoF: bogged down).
Revered and ancient forge world; well-stocked repair facility.
Field base with ample supplies; hive world of superior manufacturing prowess.
Area free from enemy fire; field encampment with basic supplies; hive world of standard prowess.
Required tools and supplies; calm weather or away from enemy fire.
Rudimentary or faulty tools; close to battlefields; run-down forge world; open without facilities; inclement weather.
Ruined forge world; storms, blizzards or sandstorms; insect swarms; under bombardment; primitive locale.
Blistering desert or ice sheet; dense jungle; poorly-supplied field base; ongoing battle; orbital bombardment; cult-dominated region.
